name: Generative Occupancy Fields (GOF)
definition: GOF is a generative model for 3D-aware image synthesis that combines radiance fields and occupancy representations to learn compact object surfaces without impeding training convergence. It solves the problem of diffused surfaces in GRAFs and the sparse gradient convergence issues in direct occupancy networks by transitioning from cumulative volume rendering to surface-point rendering.
summary: Generative Occupancy Fields is a 3D-aware image synthesis method that predicts occupancy values to locate surfaces via root-finding, producing compact and smooth geometry unlike methods with diffused surfaces.
